key_events: The party defeated an ash-boar during a standard gathering quest.
Rhea obtained a Severed Ash-Boar Tusk and 60 Copper Credits.
Vance also received 60 Copper Credits.
Rhea compared the actual payout to the raw System Formulas.
She identified a hidden 14.3% skim on all quest rewards.
Rhea used the custom party contract to force Unit 734 to reveal historical data.
The system logs showed a flat 14.3% reduction in all actual payouts compared to base yields.
Rhea compiled a ledger on scrap parchment, securing physical proof of the administrative skim.
The party prepared to hike back to the Outpost Kiosk to confront the system.
Rhea explained the 14.3% deficit to Vance during their hike back.
She used the makeshift ledger compiled on scrap parchment as visual proof.
Unit 734 warned that submitting proof of the skim would unsuppress the global system audit flag.
The party arrived at the Outpost Kiosk to confront the system's routing logic.
Rhea forced Unit 734 to dock with the Outpost Kiosk to audit the local ledger.
The system attempted to drain Rhea's stamina as a defense mechanism, but she offset it by forcing Unit 734 to convert mana to stamina.
Rhea bypassed the security filters and revealed a hidden sub-routine siphoning rewards.
She confirmed the stolen 14.3% was being routed to the local Overseer's encrypted offshore account.
The party decided to follow the physical data conduit into the Maintenance Trenches to pursue the audit.
The party entered the Maintenance Trenches.
A brass security construct attacked, reducing Vance's HP to critical levels.
Rhea destroyed a support pillar, crushing the construct and earning the party XP.
The party recovered from the fight with the security construct, with Vance at critical HP and Rhea severely drained of stamina.
They located the primary server terminal for the sector, the physical skim point for the node's accounting.
Rhea used the custom liability contract to force Unit 734 to interface with the restricted terminal.
The terminal's data stream confirmed the 14.3% maintenance allocation was a fraud.
The routing destination was revealed as Account #001-Alpha, the Overseer's personal offshore ledger.
Rhea documented the proof on her Scrap Parchment, preparing to file a metaphysical grievance.
The terminal initiated a localized memory wipe.
Vance suffered severe burns holding the vents open.
Unit 734 diverted the firewall, suffering massive efficiency loss.
Rhea extracted the Raw Data Packet.
The terminal purged its core and shut down.
The system initiated a Reclaim Purge to delete the Raw Data Packet.
Rhea accessed the Party Contract UI to exploit the Shared Debt and Liabilities clause.
Rhea flagged the Raw Data Packet as a Soul-Bound Liability under the Mutual Assured Destruction parameters.
Vance and Unit 734 confirmed the liability transfer.
The system accepted the liability, freezing the item's durability at 1%.
The Raw Data Packet was locked into Rhea's personal system inventory, safe from deletion.
